# Cream Heart (Button’s Mom)

Cream Heart is the caring but no-nonsense mother of the video-game-obsessed Button Mash in JanAnimations’ fan series *Button’s Adventures*. She knows considerably more about gaming than her son expects. She is an original character of that fan continuity, not a verified character of Hasbro’s *Friendship Is Magic* television continuity.

[![Button’s Adventures — edited production stills, JanAnimations](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/23/2108629__safe_artist-colon-jan_derpibooru%2Bimport_button%2Bmash_oc_oc-colon-cream%2Bheart_button%27s%2Badventures_button_comic_exploitable.png)](https://twibooru.org/2108629)

[![Cream Heart 3D model artwork by Silkworm](https://ponysfm.com/system/images/imgs/000/002/323/full/c10329488ac08203a0c65114f9a5d8ef.png?1680893709=)](https://ponysfm.com/revamped-cream-heart-button-s-mom)

- **Appearance:** Cream-yellow earth pony mare, caramel-brown mane and tail, red hair ties, turquoise eyes, and a pink heart with a baby bottle as her cutie mark.
- **Name and design:** Initially simply Button’s Mom. The [Fan Labor Wiki](https://mlpfanart.fandom.com/wiki/Cream_Heart) credits JanAnimations and designer Berry Sweet, and reports that the earlier name Elaina was rejected by Jan before Cream Heart was revealed in July 2018 through a LunarShine plush promotion. The original naming posts could not be directly verified, but Jan’s [archived blog](https://www.tumgik.com/askthejan) includes the 2018 Cream Heart advertisement.
- **Speaking and appearances:** Voiced by EileMonty in the pilot, premiered at GalaCon on August 4, 2013. Jan confirms the name, casting and the March 18, 2014 Hasbro cease-and-desist in his [2018 retrospective](https://www.patreon.com/JanAnimations/posts/tribute-to-our-20541523). No official television, film or comic appearance was verified for Cream Heart herself. The character also features in the 2018 plush promotion.

## Important moments

All three scenes are from *Button’s Adventures* (2013 pilot; no numbered season). See the [full pilot archive with credits](https://www.moddb.com/groups/the-bronies-of-moddb/videos/buttons-adventures-episode-pilot) and [scene transcript](https://mlpfanart.fandom.com/wiki/Button%27s_Adventures/Transcript). Exact video timestamps could not be verified.

- **Wrong day for school** — She sends an excited Button back to bed because it is Sunday, establishing their comic family dynamic.
- **Dad’s old console** — She introduces Button to his father’s vintage game system, showing that she supports his hobby.
- **Outgamed by Mom** — After discovering Button has played all night, she grounds him in the game’s fictional language, revealing her own gaming experience while setting a firm boundary.
